_comment: PRODUCTION workflow. Associate Weekly Projects Digest — sends one Telegram message per active associate (project list with progress, health, milestone overview), then one AI-compressed aggregate for all interns. Mirrors associate-eod-telegram-department-digest pattern. Runs every Monday 09:00 PHT. Uses intern_eod_digest_runs table with destination_key='weekly-projects-digest' for idempotency. Payload from: get_intern_weekly_projects_digest RPC on PROD Supabase (tccdupkjmwwxcvpqnpeb).
name: [Control Hub] [Prod] Associate Weekly Projects Digest

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = Array.isArray($json.body) ? $json.body : JSON.parse($json.body || '[]');
return [{ json: { rows } }];

const grouped = $('Merge Run State').first().json;
return [{ json: grouped }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "model": "gpt-5.4-mini", "max_completion_tokens": 1500, "messages": [ { "role": "system", "content": "You transform raw associate weekly project data into an ultra-brief executive digest sent via Telegram to company owners. STRICT RULES: 1. COMPRESSION: For each associate write ONE short paragraph — total active projects, key progress highlights across milestones, and any risks (at_risk or overdue health). 2. SCANNABILITY: No redundant stats. Leadership cares about momentum, milestone completion, and blockers. 3. STRUCTURE: Group strictly by Department. Optimize for narrow mobile screens. 4. NO JARGON: Plain business English. Translate progress percentages into plain language (e.g. '65% complete'). Output ONLY valid Telegram HTML. Supported tags: , . No markdown, no asterisks. Use this EXACT structure: 🗓 Weekly Projects Digest | [week_start] ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🏢 [Department Name] • [Associate Name] ([N] project[s]) ↳ Progress: [Single sentence on overall project momentum and milestone status]. ↳ Risks: [None OR the specific at-risk/overdue project and why in one sentence]. [repeat for each associate in the department] ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ [repeat for each department]" }, { "role": "user", "content": {{ JSON.stringify('Transform this associate weekly project dataset into an executive digest. Week of: ' + $json.weekStart + ' Dataset: ' + JSON.stringify($json.interns)) }} } ] }
